title: GGPP branches into defined C20 precursors and frameworks.
GGPP에서 입체배열이 정해진 C20 전구체와 골격으로.
intro: Follow class II products, match compatible class I enzymes and locate their precursor frameworks. Use the second view for C20 ring fusion, rearrangements and clerodane relative classes.
Class II 산물과 기질이 맞는 class I 효소를 따라 전구체 골격을 살펴보세요. C20 고리 융합·재배열·clerodane 상대배열은 두 번째 보기에서 확인합니다.

layers.label: CLASS I TPS REFERENCES / DISTINGUISH ANALYTICAL TREATMENT

edges.label: (+)-CPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces (+)-CPP. Different CPP stereoisomers are separate substrates.

edges.label: ent-CPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces ent-CPP, a substrate for ent-kaurene synthases.

edges.label: syn-CPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces syn-CPP; rice OsCPS4 is a characterized example.

edges.label: HPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces halimadienyl/tuberculosinyl diphosphate. The HPP stereochemistry and double-bond positions must be stated.

edges.label: KPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces a specific KPP/CLPP stereoisomer. It does not stand for every cis/trans clerodane variant.

edges.label: SmKSL1 · TPS I
edges.detail: Characterized Salvia miltiorrhiza class I enzyme converts normal/(+)-CPP to miltiradiene. This is an abietane-related C20 product.

edges.label: AtKS / SrKS · TPS I
edges.detail: ent-Kaurene synthases ionize ent-CPP and form a tetracyclic C20 skeleton. This is a specific precursor–enzyme match.

edges.label: OsKSL11 · TPS I
edges.detail: Rice stemod-13(17)-ene synthase (historically OsKSL11; also OsKSL8i) uses syn-CPP. It is an example of a class I step after syn-CPS.

edges.label: SsSS · TPS I · tested pairing
edges.detail: In the characterized combinatorial system, Salvia sclarea sclareol synthase accepts tuberculosinyl diphosphate and yields (13S)-isotuberculosinol. This is an experimentally demonstrated cross-species pairing, not a claim that SsSS is the native mycobacterial enzyme. The drawing leaves C13 unassigned.

edges.label: SsSS · TPS I · tested pairing
edges.detail: Sclareol synthase SsSS accepts compatible KPP in characterized combinatorial systems and yields kolavelool. This tertiary alcohol differs from kolavenol. The generic PubChem drawing leaves stereochemistry unassigned; the cited experiment specifies the product.

edges.label: Taxadiene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: A direct GGPP-using class I cyclase. Not every diterpene pathway requires a class II step first.

edges.label: multiple CYP oxidations
edges.detail: Several oxidation steps, not a single enzyme reaction.

edges.label: Salvia pathway · multiple steps
edges.detail: A separate route from KPP through multiple reactions. Kolavelool from the SsSS test pairing is not asserted to be an intermediate in salvinorin A biosynthesis.

edges.label: C20 clerodane backbone
edges.detail: A structural relationship, not an additional biochemical conversion.

edges.label: other CLPP configurations · TPS II
edges.detail: Alternative characterized class II products include cis-trans and cis-cis CLPP configurations. A specific downstream TPS pairing must be established for each precursor; the pictured KPP example is not universal.

edges.label: clerodane scaffold membership
edges.detail: Scaffold classification only. These are already C20 clerodane-related intermediates, not a universal pathway through the depicted (−)-KPP.

edges.label: Source relative class
edges.detail: The model retains a real diphosphate-bearing C20 connectivity while explicitly omitting unassigned absolute and side-chain configurations.

edges.label: Source relative class

edges.label: Alternative substrate study
edges.detail: NNPP changes product stereochemistry in studied PvCPS1 systems; it does not identify a native Tinospora route.

edges.label: Added phosphatase - assay
edges.detail: Analytical treatment in the cited SdKPS study. Alcohol detection after phosphatase does not prove a native class I reaction. Kolavenol differs from the tertiary alcohol kolavelool.

edges.label: Precursor framework membership
edges.detail: A carbon-framework classification of the diphosphate precursor, not an additional enzyme step. Specific configurations remain attached to the individual precursor record.
